summary: v2a adapter epoch1, 2x corpus, greedy decoding
hypothesis: Doubling the training corpus (312→619) and switching to greedy decoding should push the adapter meaningfully above the ~0.32 in-context plateau, because more diverse training pairs improve generalisation and greedy decoding removes the sampling noise that was masking the adapter's real quality.
technique: A single greedy on-device call using the v2a LoRA adapter (fine-tuned on 558 train pairs from the expanded 619-item corpus, lr 5e-4, early-stopped at epoch 1 before overfitting). Decoding switched from stochastic sampling to deterministic greedy to eliminate small-model output noise.
result: Scored 0.409 on the full-30 gate (2 wins / 5 ties / 22 losses vs Sonnet), a real step above the v1 adapter (0.362) and the ~0.32 in-context plateau; specificity and naturalness rose to 4 but coverage stayed at 3, so the bet partly paid off — kept as the new best, still short of parity.
